thread:
harry: Hey folks, opening my first PR to clean up a racey logger in runtime. Quick q before I push: preferred branch name convention and reviewers for a small infra-adjacent fix?

maya: We use `feature/` or `fix/` prefixes with the ticket. e.g. `fix/TKT-4321-racy-logger`. Keep the description short.

harry: thanks. And do we squash or keep merge commits?

maya: squash for tiny fixes. If the change touches multiple subsystems (runtime + infra) keep a merge commit and note the rollout plan.

olivia: Add a one-line summary at top of PR body, then a short before/after and how to test locally. If CI or deploy is involved tag @eng-infra and @eng-runtime.

harry: ran pre-commit and hit style errors: 
```
black................................Failed
isort................................Failed
```

maya: run `pre-commit run --all-files` or `make format`. Black + isort usually autofix. If commit still fails do `git add -A && git commit --amend --no-edit`.

nate: For reviewers: at least one code-owner must approve. For infra/CI touches get an eng-infra approver. Small doc-only PRs can do a single reviewer.

harry: CI bot kicked off: 

ci-bot: Build started for commit def456 — https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/1234 :gear:

harry: Anything special about changelogs?

olivia: Add a changelog line if it's user-facing or affects deployment. Put the entry under `changelogs/unreleased/` with the ticket ref.

maya: Branching notes: main is protected. Create feature branches off main. Rebase rather than merging main into your branch to keep history clean.

nate: If your branch will be open for >3 days, open a draft PR and keep it rebased. Also ping #release-war-room if it might impact a release window.

harry: PR size limits?

olivia: Try to keep <500 LOC. If larger, split into smaller logical PRs.

harry: sweet — pushing shortly. If someone has 10 mins for a quick paired review ping me @maya? :wave:

maya: I can pair after standup, happy to help with the pre-commit bits. :thumbsup:
